notes:
Inbound SMB lead via self-serve signup (trial credits). Customer runs a lightweight SaaS chat/support product (web + mobile). Key theme: must survive marketing-driven traffic spikes without dev ops overhead.

Discovery summary:
- CTO (Anika Patel) initial call 2026-02-25 — wants clear behavior for 429s and concurrency throttles. Quote: "We get daily spikes after email campaigns; 429s kill the UX."
- They're evaluating hosted APIs only for now; no Private/Dedicated interest in this stage.
- Primary ask: straightforward quota tiers with predictable burst allowances and visible rate-limit metrics in console.

Technical constraints / preferences:
- Workloads: chat (real-time support), embeddings for search, light reranking for top-k.
- Latency target: 150-500ms for token responses (front-end experience), spike tolerance up to 2s for degraded paths.
- Throughput: baseline 20–60 requests/sec; expected spikes to 300+ reqs/sec for 3–10 minutes after campaigns.
- Cost sensitivity: high — prefer small/quantized models for inference where possible.
- Model pref: open small/medium footprints; want automatic fallback to lower-cost model if primary is throttled.
- Client constraints: single API key per microservice, want per-key concurrency limits and per-minute token quotas.

Operational expectations:
- Need Retry guidance: explicit Retry-After header support, recommended backoff strategy (server-provided), and examples in SDKs.
- Console: real-time rate-limit charts, alerting on sustained 429 spikes, token/burst usage split by route.
- Quotas: ability to programmatically request temporary burst increases (self-serve) during campaigns.

POC plan / timeline:
- 2026-03-02: sandbox API key issued, initial smoke test passed.
- 2026-03-09: first stress run with dev team — observed 7–12% 429 rate at 200 rps for 3 min. Need to reproduce with Redwood telemetry and recommended client retry.
- Next: schedule 30m dev sync week of 2026-03-15 to run burst test harness with console visibility.

Sales notes / positioning:
- SMB self-serve conversion likely if we show clear docs + SDK retry + transient burst allowance.
- Upsell path: Dedicated only if they outgrow hosted economics and require reserved throughput.

Action items owned:
- AE (Maya): send pricing flash for burst add-on + sample Retry-After SDK snippet (by 2026-03-11).
- SE (Liam): prepare burst test plan and metric dashboard view; join dev sync.

Stated blocker from CTO: "We need an easy knob to avoid 429s during launches — without a big procurement cycle."
